text.raid-race.error.read: Couldn't read the pull data file!
text.raid-race.error.write: Couldn't write reward pulls to the data file, please report this with the error logs!
text.raid-race.error.unmatched-chest: Couldn't match a raid to your location, please report this as it won't log these rewards!
text.raid-race.help.pulls: Displays how many reward pulls you've logged, both for this session and overall.
text.raid-race.help.file: Open the folder where the reward data is stored
text.raid-race.help.silent: Hides the message that displays after opening a reward chest.
text.raid-race.help.time: Tells you how much time is left for the event.
text.raid-race.pulls-logged: Logged %1$s new reward pulls (%2$s this session)
text.raid-race.silent.off: You will see the message after opening a reward chest again.
text.raid-race.silent.on: You will no longer see the message after opening a reward chest.
text.raid-race.time.ended: The event has ended, thank you for participating!
